name: Nadiral-Orrery
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an ancient meteor crater, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
